items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He’d have some jive organist play. And then he’d have Wild Bill Davis.

ctx.x: Who were some of the acts, the talent, that were booked into the club?
He’d have some jive organist play. And then he’d have Wild Bill Davis.
Was it musicians that would be competing with you for gigs? Different style?
